title: FDA approval of midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for PTSD
proposition: The FDA approves midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for post-traumatic stress disorder.

title: MAPP1 Phase 3 trial of MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD meets its primary endpoint
proposition: MAPP1 (NCT03537014), the first Phase 3 trial of MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD, reports its prespecified primary endpoint met with statistical significance.

title: FDA approval of a psilocybin drug product
proposition: The FDA approves a drug product whose active ingredient is psilocybin for any indication.

title: EU approval of midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for PTSD
proposition: The European Medicines Agency's CHMP gives a positive opinion, or the European Commission grants a marketing authorisation, for midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for post-traumatic stress disorder.

title: Federal ERISA enforcement action over post-Dobbs abortion coverage
gate_reason: An ERISA enforcement action over abortion-related health coverage is not a decision about a psychiatric drug, device or treatment or its payment.
proposition: A federal agency (the Department of Labor or the Department of Justice) brings an ERISA-based enforcement action concerning abortion-related health coverage or care after the Dobbs decision.

title: Cerebral: government enforcement outcome over its prescribing practices
proposition: A court or government agency convicts, sanctions, rules against, or accepts a settlement from Cerebral (or its executives) for regulatory violations or crimes in its prescribing or business practices.

title: SNT or accelerated iTBS for depression: a subsequent RCT meets its primary endpoint
proposition: A randomized controlled trial of SNT or another accelerated iTBS protocol for depression, reported after 11 July 2022, meets its prespecified primary endpoint with statistical significance.

title: Employer-sponsored family health premiums rise year over year
gate_reason: Employer-sponsored health premiums are a general employment-benefit cost, not payment for or access to a psychiatric treatment.
proposition: The average annual premium for employer-sponsored family coverage in a survey year exceeds the prior survey year's average, per the KFF Employer Health Benefits Survey.

title: US national health expenditures rise year over year
gate_reason: Total US national health expenditure is a general health-spending metric, not a measure about psychiatric treatments or their payment.
proposition: Total US national health expenditures for a calendar year exceed the prior calendar year's total, per the CMS National Health Expenditure Accounts.

title: DEA per-state physical-location registration requirement for controlled-substance prescribing is rescinded
proposition: The DEA adopts a final rule that lets a practitioner prescribe controlled substances to patients located in a state outside the states where the practitioner holds a registration at a physical location.

title: SAINT neuromodulation system becomes commercially available in the US
proposition: Magnus Medical makes the SAINT neuromodulation system commercially available to patients in the United States.

title: MAPP2 Phase 3 trial of MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD meets its primary endpoint
proposition: MAPP2 (NCT04077437), the second Phase 3 trial of MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD, reports its prespecified primary endpoint met with statistical significance.

title: A Phase 3 trial of a psilocybin drug product starts
proposition: A sponsor starts a Phase 3 clinical trial of a psilocybin drug product for any indication.

title: HIPAA enforcement action over BetterHelp user-data sharing
gate_reason: A HIPAA enforcement action over user-data sharing is a privacy matter, not a decision about a psychiatric treatment or its payment.
proposition: HHS Office for Civil Rights or the Department of Justice announces a HIPAA enforcement action (resolution agreement, civil monetary penalty or criminal charge) against BetterHelp or Teladoc Health over the user-data sharing described in the FTC complaint.

title: BetterHelp or Teladoc Health ceases operations
proposition: BetterHelp or its parent Teladoc Health ceases operations (shuts down, files for bankruptcy or is dissolved).

title: DEA February 2023 proposed telemedicine controlled-substance rule is revised, withdrawn or replaced
proposition: DEA revises, withdraws or replaces its February 2023 proposed rule on telemedicine prescribing of controlled substances rather than finalizing it as proposed.

title: A depression practice guideline lists TMS as a first-line treatment
proposition: The American Psychiatric Association issues a practice guideline for major depressive disorder that lists TMS (including accelerated protocols) as a first-line treatment option.

title: DEA extends the COVID-era telemedicine flexibilities for controlled-substance prescribing past the PHE end
proposition: DEA issues a rule or order that extends the COVID-era telemedicine flexibilities for prescribing controlled substances beyond the end of the COVID-19 public health emergency.

title: DEA extends the COVID-era telemedicine flexibilities for controlled-substance prescribing a second time
proposition: DEA issues a second rule or order that extends the COVID-era telemedicine flexibilities for prescribing controlled substances beyond the end date set by the first extension.

title: Substack shuts down or files for bankruptcy
gate_reason: Substack is a general publishing platform, not a company in the psychiatric treatment field.
proposition: Substack shuts down its publishing platform or files for bankruptcy.

title: Medicare new technology add-on payment for SAINT Neuromodulation
proposition: CMS approves a Medicare New Technology Add-On Payment (NTAP) for SAINT Neuromodulation under the inpatient prospective payment system.

title: SAINT neuromodulation becomes available to patients in a US hospital setting
proposition: SAINT (fMRI-guided accelerated iTBS) is offered to patients in at least one US hospital setting, as announced by Magnus Medical or the hospital.

title: Medicare new technology add-on payment for a psychedelic medicine
proposition: CMS approves a Medicare new technology add-on payment (NTAP) for a psychedelic medicine (a psychedelic-class drug, or a therapy that administers one) in an inpatient prospective payment system final rule.

title: FDA authorizes a TMS device for a new indication
proposition: The FDA grants a 510(k) clearance, De Novo authorization or PMA approval for a transcranial magnetic stimulation device for a disease or condition beyond those authorized for any TMS device at the statement date.

title: UnitedHealth Group discloses a material financial impact from the Change Healthcare cyberattack
gate_reason: The financial impact of a cyberattack on UnitedHealth Group is not an outcome about a psychiatric treatment or its payment.
proposition: UnitedHealth Group discloses in an SEC filing that the February 2024 Change Healthcare cyberattack has had, or is reasonably likely to have, a material impact on its financial condition or results of operations.

title: BPL-003 (5-MeO-DMT) Phase 2b trial in treatment-resistant depression reports topline results
proposition: Beckley Psytech or its parent reports topline results, positive or negative, of the Phase 2b trial of BPL-003 in treatment-resistant depression.

title: HIPAA penalties over the Change Healthcare breach exceed $40 million
gate_reason: HIPAA penalties over the Change Healthcare data breach are a privacy and cybersecurity matter, not a psychiatric treatment outcome.
proposition: HIPAA civil money penalties or settlement payments imposed by HHS Office for Civil Rights on UnitedHealth Group, Optum or Change Healthcare over the Change Healthcare breach total more than $40 million.

title: UnitedHealth Group executive sentenced to prison in a DOJ case
gate_reason: A prison sentence for a UnitedHealth Group executive in the DOJ antitrust or cyberattack case concerns no psychiatric treatment or its payment.
proposition: A federal court sentences a UnitedHealth Group, Optum or Change Healthcare executive or employee to imprisonment on criminal charges brought by the Department of Justice in connection with its antitrust investigation of UnitedHealth Group or the Change Healthcare cyberattack.

title: Documentation shows UnitedHealth Group knew of the Change Healthcare intrusion before disclosure
gate_reason: The timing of UnitedHealth Group's knowledge of a cyberattack is not a decision about a psychiatric treatment or its payment.
proposition: A public regulator finding, court filing, congressional record or company filing documents that UnitedHealth Group, Optum or Change Healthcare knew of the Change Healthcare intrusion before its first public disclosure of the incident.

title: PCN-101 (arketamine) development is discontinued
proposition: The sponsor of PCN-101 (arketamine) announces that clinical development of the program is discontinued.

title: A new Phase 3 trial of midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for PTSD reports its primary result
proposition: The sponsor of midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for PTSD reports the primary endpoint result of a Phase 3 trial that starts after 5 June 2024.

title: REMS requirement on FDA-approved psychedelic medicines
proposition: Every psychedelic medicine the FDA approves carries a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) on its label at approval.

title: First FDA approval of a psychedelic medicine (class)
proposition: The FDA approves at least one psychedelic medicine (class reading) for any indication.

title: DOJ charges a second telehealth company over controlled-substance prescribing
proposition: The Department of Justice announces criminal charges against a second telehealth or digital health company, or its executives, for unlawful distribution of controlled substances prescribed through the company's platform.

title: FDA approval of prazosin for PTSD or PTSD-associated nightmares
proposition: The FDA approves prazosin for post-traumatic stress disorder or for PTSD-associated nightmares, a new labeled indication for any prazosin product.

title: HIPAA Privacy Rule struck down or repealed
gate_reason: The HIPAA Privacy Rule is a privacy rule, not a decision about a psychiatric treatment or its payment.
proposition: HIPAA is overturned: a final federal court ruling holds the HIPAA Privacy Rule or HIPAA's privacy provisions unconstitutional or otherwise invalid nationwide, or Congress repeals them.

title: FDA non-approval of the midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) NDA cites insufficient safety data
proposition: The FDA's action on the Lykos Therapeutics midomafetamine NDA under review in June 2024 informs the sponsor that the application lacks the safety data necessary for approval: a complete response letter or other written non-approval that cites insufficient safety data or requests additional safety data.

title: atai Life Sciences market capitalization at or above US$10 billion
proposition: The market capitalization of atai Life Sciences (Nasdaq: ATAI, or its successor listing) is at or above US$10 billion at a market close, per Nasdaq closing price and shares outstanding in SEC filings.

title: Individual employer-side fiduciary held personally liable in an ERISA health-plan case
gate_reason: Personal liability of employer health-plan fiduciaries under ERISA is an employment-benefits legal outcome with no psychiatric treatment at issue.
proposition: A US court holds one or more natural-person plan fiduciaries (employer officers, directors or benefits committee members) personally liable for breach of ERISA fiduciary duty in a case concerning an employer-sponsored health benefit plan.

title: Johnson & Johnson loses or settles Lewandowski v. Johnson & Johnson
gate_reason: Lewandowski v. Johnson & Johnson concerns prescription-drug costs in an employee health plan, not a psychiatric treatment or its payment.
proposition: The court finds Johnson & Johnson or its plan fiduciaries liable for breach of ERISA fiduciary duty, or Johnson & Johnson settles with payment to the class, in Lewandowski v. Johnson & Johnson.

title: A major regulator approves an atai psychedelic therapeutic
proposition: The FDA or another major regulator approves a psychedelic therapeutic developed, owned or partnered by atai Life Sciences for any indication.

title: Wells Fargo loses or settles the ERISA health-plan fiduciary class action
gate_reason: The Wells Fargo ERISA class action concerns prescription-drug costs in an employee health plan, not a psychiatric treatment or its payment.
proposition: The court finds Wells Fargo & Company or its plan fiduciaries liable for breach of ERISA fiduciary duty, or Wells Fargo settles with payment to the class, in the July 2024 class action over prescription drug costs in its employee health plan.

title: FDA grants the Lykos appeal of the 2024 midomafetamine complete response letter
proposition: The FDA grants Lykos Therapeutics' request for reconsideration or formal dispute resolution appeal of the August 2024 complete response letter for midomafetamine for PTSD.

title: CY2025 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule conversion factor below CY2024
gate_reason: The CY2025 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule conversion factor is a Medicare-wide physician payment rate, not a payment rule for psychiatric treatments.
proposition: The CY2025 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule conversion factor in the CMS final rule is below the CY2024 conversion factor, per the CMS PFS final rule in the Federal Register.

title: Criminal charges over Acadia Healthcare involuntary psychiatric holds
proposition: A federal or state prosecutor files criminal charges against Acadia Healthcare or one or more of its current or former employees or executives over the involuntary psychiatric holds alleged in the New York Times investigation.

title: Litigation filed over Acadia Healthcare involuntary psychiatric holds
proposition: A lawsuit or government enforcement action over the involuntary psychiatric holds alleged in the New York Times investigation is filed against Acadia Healthcare.

title: Parity litigation or enforcement over UnitedHealthcare/Optum pre-payment review of mental health claims
proposition: A lawsuit or a regulator enforcement action alleging that UnitedHealthcare, United Behavioral Health or Optum's pre-payment review of mental health claims violates mental health parity law is filed.

title: FDA approval of xanomeline-trospium (Cobenfy) for bipolar disorder
proposition: The FDA approves xanomeline-trospium (Cobenfy) for a bipolar disorder indication.

title: Anti-kickback safe harbor for PBM rebates rescinded
gate_reason: The anti-kickback safe harbor for PBM rebates is general prescription-drug pricing policy, not payment for or access to a psychiatric treatment.
proposition: The federal government removes anti-kickback statute safe-harbor protection for rebates paid by prescription drug manufacturers to pharmacy benefit managers.

title: UnitedHealth Group files a defamation suit against Elisabeth Potter
gate_reason: A defamation suit by UnitedHealth Group against a physician is not about a psychiatric treatment or its payment.
proposition: UnitedHealth Group or a subsidiary files a defamation lawsuit against Elisabeth Potter in any court.

title: UnitedHealth Group defamation suit against Elisabeth Potter dismissed or lost
gate_reason: A defamation suit by UnitedHealth Group against a physician is not about a psychiatric treatment or its payment.
proposition: A court dismisses, or enters judgment against UnitedHealth Group in, a defamation suit brought by UnitedHealth Group against Elisabeth Potter over her statements about a UnitedHealthcare prior-authorization call.

title: Early-TMS trial (rTMS/iTBS versus SSRI for depression in pregnancy) reports its primary result
proposition: The Early-TMS randomized trial reports its primary comparison of rTMS/iTBS versus SSRI treatment in pregnant women with depression (either direction).

title: Lawsuit filed over the Cigna/Evernorth adolescent TMS coverage policy
proposition: A lawsuit is filed in a US court against Cigna or Evernorth that challenges, or alleges harm from, the adolescent TMS coverage policy's requirement of prior antidepressant trials.

title: Cigna/Evernorth adolescent TMS coverage policy: prior antidepressant-trial requirement
proposition: Cigna/Evernorth removes the prior antidepressant-trial (medication failure) requirement for adolescents from its national coverage policy for TMS in adolescent depression.

title: FDA clearance of PRISM (GrayMatters Health) for depression
proposition: FDA grants clearance for PRISM (GrayMatters Health EEG neurofeedback) for the indication of depression treatment.

title: FDA approval of brexpiprazole plus sertraline for PTSD
proposition: The FDA approves brexpiprazole (Rexulti) in combination with sertraline for the treatment of post-traumatic stress disorder.

title: UnitedHealthcare covers accelerated TMS for depression
proposition: UnitedHealthcare adopts a medical policy that covers an accelerated TMS protocol (more than one TMS session per day) for depression in human patients.

title: Enactment of S.1717, the Ensuring Patient Access to Critical Breakthrough Products Act
proposition: Congress enacts S.1717, the Ensuring Patient Access to Critical Breakthrough Products Act of 2025, into law.

title: EMP-01 (R-MDMA) Phase 2 trial in social anxiety disorder reports topline results
proposition: atai Life Sciences reports topline results, positive or negative, of the Phase 2 trial of EMP-01 (R-MDMA) in social anxiety disorder.

title: Done Global second federal indictment: conviction
proposition: Done Global, or an executive of Done Global charged in the December 2025 federal indictment of Done Global and Mindful Mental Wellness P.A., is convicted (jury verdict or accepted guilty plea) on that indictment.

title: 2026 venture investment in AI-enabled BCI and neuromodulation companies at or above US$600 million
proposition: Disclosed venture investment into AI-enabled BCI and neuromodulation health-tech companies during calendar 2026 is at or above USD 600 million.

title: Brainsonix transcranial focused ultrasound trial reports topline results
proposition: Brainsonix, or the investigators of a clinical trial of a Brainsonix transcranial focused ultrasound device, publicly report topline (primary-outcome) results of that trial, in any direction.

title: ERISA fiduciary lawsuit citing mental health parity (MHPAEA) violations is filed
proposition: A lawsuit is filed in a US federal court that pleads an ERISA breach-of-fiduciary-duty claim against the sponsor or fiduciaries of an employer group health plan and cites violations of the Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act as a basis for the breach.

title: FDA approval of COMP360 (psilocybin) for major depressive disorder
proposition: The FDA approves COMP360 (psilocybin) for a major depressive disorder indication.

title: FDA approval of KetaFree (NRX-100 intravenous ketamine) for major depressive disorder
proposition: The FDA approves NRx Pharmaceuticals' intravenous ketamine product (KetaFree) for a major depressive disorder indication.

title: Global antidepressant prescription volume falls in 2026 versus 2025
proposition: Global antidepressant prescription volume for calendar year 2026 is below the volume for calendar year 2025, per IQVIA's global data.

title: A national US payer covers accelerated TMS in the outpatient clinic setting
proposition: A US health payer with national scope covers accelerated TMS delivered in outpatient clinics, through a published coverage policy or a publicly announced pilot or network agreement.

title: A pediatric or child-psychiatry society warns against non-fluoxetine antidepressants for youth depression
proposition: A professional society for children's health care issues a warning, policy statement or clinical guideline that recommends against prescribing antidepressant medications other than fluoxetine for depression in children and adolescents.

title: Sanmai transcranial focused ultrasound trial reports topline results
proposition: Sanmai, or the investigators of a clinical trial of Sanmai's transcranial focused ultrasound therapy, publicly report topline (primary-outcome) results of that trial, in any direction.

title: Three or more at-home depression treatment devices on the US market
proposition: By the period end, three or more distinct hardware devices with an FDA authorization naming a depressive disorder indication and home use are commercially available in the United States, per FDA device databases and sponsor availability announcements.

title: At least two new federal criminal cases against companies selling controlled substances
proposition: US federal prosecutors bring at least two additional criminal cases, of the kind brought against Done Global, against companies (or their principals) for selling or prescribing controlled substances.

title: At least two pandemic-era mental-health companies cease operations
proposition: At least two pandemic-era (founded or grown during the COVID-19 pandemic) mental-health companies publicly announce that they are ceasing operations.

title: An additional US health plan covers TMS for adolescent depression
proposition: An additional US health plan, beyond those that covered TMS for adolescent depression on 5 January 2026, adopts a coverage policy that covers TMS for depression in adolescents.

title: Monarch eTNS large-scale replication trial results are published
proposition: Results of a randomized controlled replication trial of the Monarch eTNS device, larger than the trial behind its existing FDA clearance, are published, in any direction.

title: FDA action (approval or complete response letter) on the COMP360 NDA for treatment-resistant depression
proposition: The FDA issues its action (approval or complete response letter) on Compass Pathways' new drug application for COMP360 (psilocybin) in treatment-resistant depression.

title: AtaiBeckley (ATAI) added to a major stock index
proposition: AtaiBeckley (atai Life Sciences, Nasdaq: ATAI) is added to a major stock market index, per the index provider's announcement.

title: Kale Award trial (bilateral versus unilateral TMS for suicidal ideation) reports its primary result
proposition: The Kale Award trial reports its primary comparison of bilateral versus unilateral stimulation for suicidal ideation (either direction).

title: FDA or DEA opens a legal pathway to ibogaine treatment in the United States
proposition: The FDA or the DEA issues a final rule, guidance, order or program that permits patients in the United States to receive ibogaine treatment lawfully outside a registered clinical trial.

title: A US health plan covers accelerated TMS for PTSD, bipolar disorder, OCD or ADHD
proposition: A US health plan publishes a medical policy that covers accelerated TMS as medically necessary for at least one of PTSD, bipolar disorder, OCD or ADHD.

title: FDA authorizes a TMS device for ADHD
proposition: The FDA grants a marketing authorization (510(k) clearance, De Novo grant or PMA approval) for a transcranial magnetic stimulation device whose indications for use include ADHD.

title: An additional US health plan covers accelerated TMS
proposition: A US health plan other than Premera, Highmark, CareFirst and the Blue Cross Blue Shield plans of California, South Carolina, Texas and Vermont publishes a medical policy that covers accelerated TMS.

title: DT120 (LSD) Voyage Phase 3 trial in generalized anxiety disorder reports its topline result
proposition: Definium Therapeutics reports the topline primary endpoint result of the Voyage Phase 3 trial (NCT06741228) of DT120 in generalized anxiety disorder (either direction).

title: First FDA approval of a psilocybin, LSD or MDMA drug product
proposition: The FDA approves at least one drug product whose active ingredient is psilocybin, LSD (lysergide) or MDMA (midomafetamine), for any indication.

title: Psilocybin, LSD or MDMA drug product approved with retail-pharmacy dispensing
proposition: The FDA approves a psilocybin, LSD or MDMA drug product whose approved labeling or REMS permits a retail pharmacy to dispense it to the patient for use outside a healthcare setting.

title: FDA approves a psychedelic drug product with no required post-dose monitoring
proposition: The FDA approves a novel psychedelic drug product whose labeling and REMS omit any requirement for in-clinic monitoring of the patient during and after dosing.

title: Psychedelic drug product labeling or REMS requires video recording of dosing sessions
proposition: FDA approves a novel psychedelic drug product whose labeling or REMS requires video recording (auditable video) of dosing sessions.
